name: Salesforce
one_liner: Enterprise CRM and the reference implementation for OAuth2-gated SaaS.
access_note: Free Developer Edition org; connected app gives OAuth2 without sales contact.
blocker: Per-org API call limits on low editions; sandbox setup is heavy.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: SMB CRM and marketing automation suite.
access_note: Free developer account + private app token works immediately.
blocker: Legacy API keys deprecated in favour of private-app tokens.

name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Sales-pipeline CRM aimed at SMB sales teams.
access_note: API token lives in any paid seat; 14-day trial issues one.
blocker: No permanent free tier; token dies with the trial.

name: Attio
one_liner: Modern relationship-first CRM with a flexible data model.
access_note: Free plan issues API keys from workspace settings.
blocker: None material.

name: Twenty
one_liner: Open-source CRM positioned as a Salesforce/HubSpot alternative.
access_note: Open-source; self-host free, or Twenty Cloud. Key from Settings > Developers > API.
blocker: GraphQL introspection disabled for API keys on self-hosted instances.

name: Podio
one_liner: Legacy collaborative work-management and lightweight CRM platform.
access_note: Free tier; Podio API keys self-generated.
blocker: Product is in maintenance mode; low investment from Citrix.

name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: Full-suite CRM inside the broader Zoho business-app ecosystem.
access_note: Free tier for up to 3 users; self-serve OAuth client in Zoho API console.
blocker: Data-centre-specific domains (.com/.eu/.in) complicate token routing.

name: Close
one_liner: Inside-sales CRM with built-in calling and email sequencing.
access_note: API key in every paid plan; no free tier.
blocker: Paid plan required before a key exists.

name: Copper
one_liner: Google-Workspace-native CRM for SMB sales teams.
access_note: Developer API key from user settings on a paid plan.
blocker: Paid plan required; API is narrow.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: Deal and relationship management for private capital markets.
access_note: Client ID/secret issued by a DealCloud administrator on a licensed instance; no public signup.
blocker: Private-equity SaaS with no self-serve tenant; needs a customer instance plus admin-granted scopes.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Incumbent helpdesk and customer-service suite.
access_note: Free trial subdomain; API token from admin centre.
blocker: Trial expiry; some endpoints need paid add-ons.

name: Intercom
one_liner: Customer messaging, support inbox and in-product engagement.
access_note: Developer Hub workspace is free; access token issued instantly.
blocker: Production install needs an app listing for multi-workspace use.

name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Helpdesk ticketing in the Freshworks suite.
access_note: Free plan; API key on the agent profile page.
blocker: Per-plan rate limits are tight on free tier.

name: Front
one_liner: Shared-inbox collaboration for customer-facing teams.
access_note: API token from settings on a paid plan; trial available.
blocker: No free tier.

name: Pylon
one_liner: B2B support platform built around shared Slack/Teams channels.
access_note: Admin-only token from the Pylon dashboard; paid product, no free tier.
blocker: Token creation is admin-gated and there is no free workspace.

name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Helpdesk with ticketing, live chat and call-centre features.
access_note: v3 key from Configuration > System > API; admin-only, paid or trial instance.
blocker: Docs are only reachable inside a logged-in instance; v1/v3 keys are not interchangeable.

name: Plain
one_liner: Modern B2B support tool with a GraphQL-first API.
access_note: Machine user + scoped API key from settings; paid product.
blocker: GraphQL-only surface; official MCP is OAuth-only and rejects API keys.

name: Help Scout
one_liner: Email-first helpdesk for small support teams.
access_note: Free trial; OAuth app self-registered in developer settings.
blocker: Paid plan after trial.

name: Gorgias
one_liner: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk tightly coupled to Shopify.
access_note: API key from store settings on a paid Gorgias plan.
blocker: Paid ecommerce-support plan required.

name: Gladly
one_liner: Enterprise customer-service platform organised around people, not tickets.
access_note: Token requires an API-role user on a licensed Gladly org; no self-serve tenant.
blocker: Enterprise-only contract; no trial org to obtain credentials from.

name: Slack
one_liner: Team chat and the de-facto surface for workplace bots.
access_note: Free workspace; bot token issued instantly from api.slack.com/apps.
blocker: Granular scope model; some events need app review for distribution.

name: Twilio
one_liner: Programmable messaging, voice and verification APIs.
access_note: Free trial account with credit; credentials visible on signup.
blocker: Trial restricts verified destination numbers.

name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Team chat inside the Zoho suite.
access_note: Free tier; OAuth client from Zoho API console.
blocker: Data-centre-specific domains.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: Collaboration suite combining chat, docs and calendar.
access_note: Free Lark/Feishu developer tenant; app credentials self-serve.
blocker: Separate Lark (intl) and Feishu (CN) tenants; docs split by region.

name: Pumble
one_liner: Slack-alternative team chat from CAKE.com.
access_note: API addon installed in the workspace generates a key; addon is a paid feature.
blocker: Header name is inconsistent across Pumble's own docs and SDKs.

name: Discord
one_liner: Community chat platform with a large bot ecosystem.
access_note: Free developer portal; bot token immediately.
blocker: Privileged intents need verification above 100 guilds.

name: Telegram
one_liner: Messaging platform with the lowest-friction bot onboarding of the set.
access_note: BotFather issues a bot token in seconds, no account review.
blocker: Bot API cannot read arbitrary history; MTProto needed for user-level access.

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Business messaging over WhatsApp via Meta's Cloud API.
access_note: Meta app is self-serve, but scaling past the limited tier needs Business Verification and two-step verification.
blocker: Business verification gate plus per-message pricing; limited access tier until verified.

name: Aircall
one_liner: Cloud call centre for sales and support teams.
access_note: Admin/Owner creates keys in Company Settings; plan eligibility is not publicly stated.
blocker: Aircall does not publish which plan tiers include API access.

name: Vonage
one_liner: CPaaS for voice, SMS and verification.
access_note: Free trial with credit; key and secret on the dashboard.
blocker: Per-product auth differs (JWT for Voice, key/secret for SMS).

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Programmatic management of Google Ads campaigns and reporting.
access_note: Developer tokens were sunset 2026-09-09; access levels now attach to a Google Cloud project and Basic Access needs brand verification.
blocker: Approval gate for production accounts; the access model changed in Sept 2026.

name: Meta Ads
one_liner: Campaign management and reporting across Meta's ad surfaces.
access_note: Limited Access by default; managing other people's ad accounts needs Full Access via App Review (threshold recently cut from 1,500 to 500 calls/15 days).
blocker: App Review plus business verification before multi-tenant use.

name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: Campaign management and reporting for LinkedIn advertising.
access_note: App creation is self-serve but Marketing Developer Platform access is reviewed and LinkedIn selects partners at its discretion.
blocker: Discretionary partner approval; private APIs need a separate programme application.

name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: White-label agency CRM, funnels and marketing automation.
access_note: Free developer marketplace account; app install needs a GoHighLevel agency/sub-account.
blocker: Access tokens expire in 24h; marketplace review before public listing.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Email marketing and audience management for SMBs.
access_note: Free plan; API key from account settings.
blocker: Datacenter prefix must be parsed from the key.

name: Klaviyo
one_liner: Ecommerce-focused email and SMS marketing automation.
access_note: Free plan up to 250 contacts; private key self-serve.
blocker: Scoped private keys; revision-pinned API versions.

name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one funnel builder, email and course platform.
access_note: Free plan; up to 3 public API keys from profile settings with optional expiry.
blocker: Key limit (2-3 depending on source); thin official reference.

name: Pinterest
one_liner: Visual discovery platform with Pin and ads APIs.
access_note: App approval grants Trial access (1,000 req/day, no production Pin writes); Standard access needs a demo video and is widely reported to stall.
blocker: Trial tier blocks POST /v5/pins; Standard approval is slow and discretionary.

name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Meta's text-based social network with a publishing API.
access_note: Threads use case app is self-serve; publishing to other users' accounts needs App Review. oEmbed became tokenless in March 2026.
blocker: App Review and a data-deletion callback required before production.

name: SendGrid
one_liner: Transactional and marketing email delivery.
access_note: Free tier; key from the SendGrid dashboard. Sender verification required to send.
blocker: Sender identity verification before first send.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Hosted ecommerce platform with the broadest commerce API surface.
access_note: Free Partner account + development store; custom app token immediately.
blocker: REST Admin API is legacy-frozen; GraphQL is the forward path.

name: WooCommerce
one_liner: WordPress ecommerce plugin powering self-hosted stores.
auth_all: Consumer key + secret over HTTPS Basic
access_note: Self-hosted WordPress plugin; keys generated in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.
blocker: Requires the merchant's own WordPress host; no central tenant to authenticate against.

name: BigCommerce
one_liner: SaaS ecommerce platform aimed at mid-market merchants.
access_note: Free sandbox store; API account token from the control panel.
blocker: None material.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Enterprise B2C commerce platform in the Salesforce stack.
access_note: On-demand sandboxes need purchased sandbox credits, a realm ID and admin-assigned roles; no free developer tenant.
blocker: Credit-metered sandboxes behind an existing B2C Commerce contract.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
one_liner: Open-source and Adobe-hosted enterprise commerce platform.
access_note: Open-source Magento self-host is free; integration tokens from Admin. SaaS tier requires Adobe IMS OAuth2.
blocker: Self-host operational burden; SaaS path needs an Adobe contract.

name: Squarespace
one_liner: Website builder with a commerce API on upper tiers.
access_note: Developer API keys require a Commerce Advanced plan; keys are a paid feature.
blocker: Hard paywall: no key on lower Squarespace tiers.

name: Ecwid
one_liner: Embeddable storefront widget for existing sites.
access_note: API is available on paid plans only (Venture/Business/Unlimited); free plans cannot use it.
blocker: Paid plan gate; external apps need Ecwid support to set the return URL.

name: Gumroad
one_liner: Creator storefront for digital products.
access_note: Free seller account; token self-generated under Settings > Advanced.
blocker: Narrow API; product-centric only.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: Seller-facing API for Amazon marketplace operations.
access_note: Developer registration is reviewed: 1-2 weeks for standard roles, a three-stage review plus screen-share demo for PII roles.
blocker: Mandatory developer-profile review; restricted roles need a live demo.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: Payments and checkout infrastructure for creators and coaches.
access_note: Creator-payments platform; key scopes cover checkout-sessions, payments, webhooks, customers. No public developer portal found.
blocker: No official developer portal surfaced; best references are a vendor GitHub repo and an SDK on npm.

name: DataForSEO
one_liner: Wholesale SERP, keyword and backlink data APIs.
access_note: Free registration; separate API login/password from the dashboard. Sandbox is free for any registered user.
blocker: Sandbox returns dummy data; live calls are pay-per-use.

name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SEO platform with rank tracking and keyword research APIs.
access_note: One key covers Data and Project APIs, from the API Dashboard; credit plans are sold annually.
blocker: Annual credit packages; no meaningful free tier.

name: Ahrefs
one_liner: Backlink and SEO intelligence platform.
access_note: Ahrefs' own help centre says the API is Enterprise-only for new applications, though a second article claims Lite and above - the two conflict.
blocker: Enterprise plan (listed $1,499/mo) and conflicting official eligibility statements.

name: MrScraper
one_liner: Managed web-scraping API with proxy rotation.
access_note: Free plan; token from the dashboard. Official docs also mention Basic auth, which looks stale.
blocker: Official pages disagree on the auth header; unblocker endpoint uses a query param.

name: Apify
one_liner: Marketplace and runtime for web-scraping actors.
access_note: Free tier with monthly credits; token from console.
blocker: Actor-based model differs from plain REST resources.

name: Firecrawl
one_liner: LLM-oriented crawler that returns clean markdown.
access_note: Free tier credits; key immediately on signup.
blocker: None material.

name: Bright Data
one_liner: Proxy network and web-data collection platform.
access_note: API keys and Web Unlocker/Browser work in immediate-access mode, but Residential proxies require manual KYC that is never automatic or self-serve.
blocker: KYC compliance review gates the residential network.

name: Sherlock
one_liner: OSS CLI that hunts social-media accounts by username.
access_note: Open-source Python CLI for username enumeration across sites. No hosted service and no API.
blocker: No API to wrap; a toolkit would have to shell out to the CLI or re-implement it.

name: Waterfall.io
one_liner: Waterfall contact and company enrichment for GTM teams.
access_note: Docs are public at docs.waterfall.io but access and pricing are arranged by booking a call with the team.
blocker: No self-serve signup; key issued after a sales conversation.

name: Clay
one_liner: GTM data orchestration and enrichment workspace.
access_note: Public API key from Account settings (beta section); legacy workspace keys do not work. Enterprise People/Company API is sales-gated.
blocker: Two distinct key types; enterprise data endpoints are undocumented publicly.

name: GitHub
one_liner: Code hosting, CI and the reference developer API.
access_note: Free account; PAT in seconds. Largest toolkit in Composio's catalog (883 tools).
blocker: None material.

name: Vercel
one_liner: Frontend hosting and serverless deployment platform.
access_note: Free hobby account; token from dashboard.
blocker: None material.

name: Netlify
one_liner: Static-site hosting and edge functions.
access_note: Free tier; personal access token from user settings.
blocker: None material.

name: Cloudflare
one_liner: Edge network, DNS, Workers and security platform.
access_note: Free account; scoped API token from the dashboard.
blocker: Legacy global key still widespread in older guides.

name: Supabase
one_liner: Postgres-backed backend-as-a-service.
access_note: Free project; anon/service keys issued at project creation.
blocker: Management API vs project API keys are easily confused.

name: Neo4j
one_liner: Graph database with managed Aura hosting.
access_note: AuraDB free tier; Aura API client credentials self-serve.
blocker: Primary interface is a Bolt driver, not REST; the management API is narrow.

name: Snowflake
one_liner: Cloud data warehouse with a SQL-over-REST API.
access_note: 30-day free trial account; key-pair and PAT auth self-serve.
blocker: Trial expiry then consumption billing; auth setup is non-trivial.

name: MongoDB Atlas
one_liner: Managed MongoDB with an administration API.
access_note: Free M0 cluster; Atlas Admin API keys from the org settings.
blocker: Digest auth is unusual and trips up naive HTTP clients.

name: Datadog
one_liner: Infrastructure monitoring and observability platform.
access_note: 14-day free trial; both keys from org settings.
blocker: Two-key scheme (API + APP key) and strict site-region routing.

name: Sentry
one_liner: Error tracking and performance monitoring.
access_note: Free developer org; auth token from settings.
blocker: None material.

name: Notion
one_liner: Docs, wiki and lightweight database workspace.
access_note: Free workspace; internal integration token in one click.
blocker: Pages must be explicitly shared with the integration.

name: Airtable
one_liner: Spreadsheet-database hybrid with a clean REST API.
access_note: Free plan; personal access token self-serve.
blocker: Legacy API keys retired in favour of PATs.

name: Linear
one_liner: Issue tracking for software teams.
access_note: Free workspace; personal API key instantly.
blocker: GraphQL-only; no REST surface.

name: Jira
one_liner: Issue and project tracking from Atlassian.
access_note: Free Jira Cloud site up to 10 users; API token self-serve.
blocker: Cloud vs Data Center APIs differ substantially.

name: Asana
one_liner: Work management and task tracking.
access_note: Free tier; PAT from developer console.
blocker: None material.

name: Monday.com
one_liner: Work OS with boards, automations and dashboards.
access_note: Free plan; API token from the developer section.
blocker: GraphQL-only; complexity budget per query.

name: ClickUp
one_liner: All-in-one project management suite.
access_note: Free forever plan; personal token from settings.
blocker: None material.

name: Coda
one_liner: Doc-as-app platform blending documents and tables.
access_note: Free tier; token from account settings.
blocker: None material.

name: Smartsheet
one_liner: Spreadsheet-style work management for enterprises.
access_note: Free trial; API access is a paid-plan feature for most capabilities.
blocker: API access tied to plan tier.

name: Harvest
one_liner: Time tracking and invoicing for services businesses.
access_note: Free Harvest plan (1 seat / 2 projects) plus a 30-day trial of paid tiers; PAT and account ID from id.getharvest.com/developers. [corrected by audit]
blocker: Requires both a token and a Harvest-Account-Id header.

name: Stripe
one_liner: Payments infrastructure and the reference fintech API.
access_note: Free account; test-mode secret key before any business verification.
blocker: Live-mode charges need business verification, but the full API is testable free.

name: Plaid
one_liner: Bank account linking and financial data aggregation.
access_note: Sandbox client_id/secret are instant and free; Production access is a separate reviewed request. [corrected by audit: was SS]
blocker: Production access is reviewed; sandbox alone cannot move real money data.

name: Binance
one_liner: Cryptocurrency exchange with trading and market-data APIs.
access_note: Free account; API key/secret self-serve, subject to regional availability.
blocker: Jurisdictional restrictions; signed-request scheme.

name: Paygent Connect
one_liner: Payment gateway reseller built on NMI's platform.
access_note: Paygent Connect is NMI-powered; the gateway security key comes from a merchant control panel issued after underwriting. No public Paygent developer portal found.
blocker: Merchant account and underwriting required; no self-serve sandbox surfaced.

name: iPayX
one_liner: Payments vendor named in the research set; could not be identified.
access_note: No documentation located. Searches for ipayx.ai surfaced only unrelated 'iPay' products (iPay Ukraine, i-pay.io, Payrix). Recorded as unverified rather than guessed.
blocker: Could not locate any primary documentation for this vendor.

name: QuickBooks
one_liner: SMB accounting platform.
access_note: Free Intuit developer account + sandbox company; OAuth2 self-serve.
blocker: Production app needs Intuit review before going live.

name: Xero
one_liner: Cloud accounting for small business.
access_note: Free developer account + demo company; OAuth2 app self-serve.
blocker: App partner certification for published apps.

name: Brex
one_liner: Corporate cards and spend management.
access_note: Account admins create user tokens under Developer > Settings after accepting the access agreement; partner OAuth needs Brex approval.
blocker: Requires a funded Brex account; partner OAuth is approval-gated.

name: Ramp
one_liner: Corporate cards, bill pay and spend management.
access_note: Admin creates a developer app under Company > Developer; sandbox app issues separate credentials.
blocker: Requires an existing Ramp customer account; some scopes need a support ticket.

name: PitchBook
one_liner: Private-capital market data and research platform.
access_note: No public pricing or signup. Access via the Direct Data team; existing customers request it from Plugins & Apps. Third parties estimate $70k+/yr on top of a platform licence.
blocker: Enterprise contract plus a separate data agreement; no developer tier at all.

name: NotebookLM
one_liner: Google's source-grounded research and notebook assistant.
access_note: No consumer NotebookLM API. Notebook creation/management is GA only in NotebookLM (Gemini) Enterprise on Google Cloud; a query/chat endpoint is still an open request.
blocker: Enterprise Google Cloud licence required and the RAG query endpoint developers want does not exist.

name: Otter AI
one_liner: AI meeting transcription and notes.
access_note: Official remote MCP at mcp.otter.ai uses OAuth; no public REST reference located. Community libraries use undocumented endpoints.
blocker: No documented public REST API; MCP is the only supported programmatic surface.

name: Fathom
one_liner: AI meeting recorder and summariser.
access_note: Key from the API Access section of user settings; OAuth for multi-user apps.
blocker: Reported read-only for meetings; docs leave retry/delivery semantics undefined.

name: Consensus
one_liner: AI search engine over peer-reviewed research.
access_note: MCP server at mcp.consensus.app supports dynamic client registration; the REST API is behind a 'Request access' button.
blocker: REST access is request-gated; quotas depend on org plan.

name: Reducto
one_liner: Document parsing and extraction for AI pipelines.
access_note: Free account at studio.reducto.ai with trial credits; credit-based pricing thereafter.
blocker: Growth/Enterprise tiers are sales-led; per-document credit cost varies.

name: Devin
one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineer.
access_note: Paid Devin account required; enterprise admins mint service users. Legacy apk_ keys are not accepted by the MCP server.
blocker: Paid seat required; PATs in closed beta and unavailable for SSO accounts.

name: higgsfield
one_liner: Generative video and content creation suite.
auth_all: Key ID + secret in Authorization header
access_note: Keys from console.higgsfield.ai; Python and Node SDKs published. A hosted MCP route also exists.
blocker: Per-model access restrictions return 404/423/503 even with valid credentials.

name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: Command-line renderer for Mermaid diagrams.
access_note: Node CLI that renders Mermaid diagrams locally via Puppeteer. No hosted service, no auth, no API.
blocker: Nothing to authenticate against; a toolkit would wrap a local binary, not an API.

name: YouTube Transcript
one_liner: Hosted YouTube transcript retrieval API.
access_note: Keys from the API Keys dashboard; Swagger UI published. Base URL /api/v2.
blocker: Credit-based; failed 4xx/5xx and 429 requests cost 0 credits.

name: Grain
one_liner: Meeting recording, notes and revenue-intelligence clips.
access_note: v1 beta sunset Sept 2026; v2 is current. PATs reported Enterprise-tier only.
blocker: PAT availability tied to Enterprise tier; v1 already sunset.
